title: GRFT
summary: A fairness-testing and repair framework for individual discrimination in tabular ML classifiers, evaluated on datasets like census, credit, bank, compas, lsac and meps. It vendors an in-tree copy of the ctgan package and trains/loads CTGANSynthesizer models to generate synthetic tabular data used to build decision boundaries for its testing pipeline.
